verdict.rationale: The only in-product AI insight capabilities are waitlist or private-preview offerings. AI Notebooks in ClickStack has an agent that queries logs, traces and metrics and surfaces charts and summaries from a plain-language description [clickhouse-docs-33], and AI Functions/AI Inference Service are in private preview in ClickHouse Cloud [clickhouse-docs-38]. The MCP server only connects external assistants rather than delivering insights inside the product. Missing for 10: generally available in-product AI insights and suggestions, coverage beyond observability data, detailed documentation of insight/suggestion behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
